## Key points {.unnumbered}

- Use `<-` to assign a value to a variable and the variable name to reuse it.
- Changing a variable lets you repeat a calculation with a new value.
- R already provides the constant `pi`.
- Variable names are case sensitive; choose descriptive names such as `snake_case`.
